proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5070 *chokara gives Gujarati choro/chori and Hindi chora/chori boy/girl, with Assamese sora. The Bhil s-/ts- forms preserve the k-less stem and gender endings; child and daughter are compatible survey kinship senses. Exact survey form sori is retained.
